rows.name: 系统自动发现(FDR引擎)
rows.scope: 日历/超跌反弹/因子 · 42 预声明候选 · 跨族 BY-FDR
rows.evidence: 真存活 7 · 已淡 8 · 死 128 · 无定论 5
rows.verdict: 多数是噪声(诚实):预声明全进分母、禁挑好看的
rows.scope_en: Calendar / oversold-bounce / factors · 42 pre-registered candidates · cross-family BY-FDR
rows.verdict_en: Most are noise (honest): every pre-registered candidate counts in the denominator; no cherry-picking

rows.name: 季节/日历效应
rows.scope: 周几/月份/圣诞/节前/十年位/任期年 · 日频 S&P500
rows.evidence: 6 项检验 · 多数全样本过但现代段已淡(4 项)或检验力不足
rows.verdict: 民俗日历多被套利/样本不足——别当可交易
rows.scope_en: Day-of-week / month / Christmas / pre-holiday / decade digit / term year · daily S&P 500
rows.evidence_en: 6 tests · most pass on the full sample but have faded in the modern era (4) or lack power
rows.verdict_en: Folk calendar effects are mostly arbitraged away or under-powered — not tradeable

rows.name: BTC动量→纳指方向
rows.evidence: 条件上涨率差 14.0pp · 4 体制段同号
rows.verdict: 信号真·风险取舍：方向同号 4/4 段(其中 3 段优势≥5pp；早段约3pp接近噪声、强度随期递增)；裸 overlay 让出 2.87pp 年化，换 Sharpe 0.92 vs 0.82、回撤 -29.5% vs -36.4%(浅 6.9pp)——但属单一历史路径、无置信区间，可能不重复。要风险调整收益的可参考，要最大绝对收益的死拿更好。已对照纳指自身20日动量(同口径差 9.4pp)：BTC 多给约 4.6pp 增量、不只是大盘动量代理
rows.evidence_en: conditional up-rate gap 14.0pp · same sign across 4 regimes
rows.verdict_en: Signal is real, but it is a risk trade-off: same sign in 4/4 regime segments (3 with an edge ≥5pp; the earliest segment is ~3pp and close to noise, strength increases over time); the naive overlay gives up 2.87pp of annualised return in exchange for Sharpe 0.92 vs 0.82, drawdown -29.5% vs -36.4% (6.9pp shallower) — but this is a single historical path with no confidence interval; it may not repeat. Worth a look if you optimise risk-adjusted return; if you want maximum absolute return, just hold. Controlled for NASDAQ's own 20-day momentum (same-basis gap 9.4pp): BTC adds about 4.6pp on top — not merely a proxy for broad-market momentum

rows.name: 政治钱·参议院交易
rows.scope: 披露后45天再跟 · 持有~3月 vs SPY · 2012-2020
rows.evidence: 跟着买中位输SPY · 整体 -0.17% · 7/14议员正≈掷硬币
rows.verdict: 披露后买/跟卖都不划算,持有大盘最稳
rows.scope_en: Copy 45 days after disclosure · ~3-month hold vs SPY · 2012-2020
rows.evidence_en: copying loses to SPY at the median · overall -0.17% · 7 of 14 senators positive = coin-flip
rows.verdict_en: Neither copying buys nor following sells pays after disclosure; holding the index is steadier

rows.name: 体制→前向收益分布
rows.scope: 倒挂/VIX/信用利差 → SP500 未来1/3/6/12月 · 2000+
rows.evidence: 倒挂仅 7 个独立事件段 · SP500
rows.verdict: 曲线倒挂后 SP500 未来12月：中位 12.8%、上涨率 70%（vs 基率中位 11.1%）——但仅 7 个独立倒挂段，分布不可靠，别当规律
rows.scope_en: Curve inversion / VIX / credit spread -> S&P 500 next 1/3/6/12 months · 2000+
rows.verdict_en: After a curve inversion, S&P 500 over the next 12 months: median 12.8%, up-rate 70% (vs base-rate median 11.1%) — but only 7 independent inversion episodes, so the distribution is unreliable; do not treat it as a rule

rows.name: 美债利率→美股前向
rows.scope: 10Y收益率水平档/20日涨跌方向 → 纳指·标普 未来1/3/12月 · 2000+
rows.evidence: 纳指侧 1/18 格能与基率分开(低档1月 vs基率 0.73pp·CI [1.24, 1.98]) · 3/12 组(资产×变量×窗口)桶间关系非单调;9 个桶分时代符号翻转;18 个桶独立段 < 8(只描述、不出CI)。
rows.verdict: 只有「低利率档·1月」分得开;方向档几乎无信号;长窗口其实是宏观年代(高档跨时代翻转)——非可交易edge
rows.name_en: Treasury yields -> US stock forward returns
rows.scope_en: 10Y yield level tercile / 20-day change -> NASDAQ & S&P next 1/3/12 months · 2000+
rows.evidence_en: 1/18 NASDAQ cells separate from the base rate (low bucket 1-month: 0.73pp vs base, CI [1.24, 1.98])
rows.verdict_en: Only the low-yield 1-month cell separates; the direction dimension shows no reliable signal; longer windows really reflect which macro epoch you are in (high bucket flips sign across eras) — not a tradeable edge

rows.name: 跌后反弹(R3短期反转)
rows.scope: 极端下跌日 → 次日 · 全样本+现代段
rows.evidence: 现代段 verdict=real · 但仍约半数次日下跌
rows.verdict: 小条件边际·会被成本吃掉·非抄底信号
rows.scope_en: Extreme down days -> next day · full sample + modern era
rows.evidence_en: modern-era verdict=real · yet about half of next days still fall
rows.verdict_en: A tiny conditional edge, eaten by costs — not a dip-buying signal

note: 全站已测规律族总览。每行强制带 scope+证据+裁决+详情链接——没证据不进库。诚实立场:大多数'规律'测下来是噪声/已淡/不可靠,真存活的极少且都标了不确定性。非荐股·会错·过去≠未来。
note_en: Overview of every rule family we have tested. Each row must carry scope + evidence + verdict + a detail link — no rule enters without evidence. Honest stance: most 'rules' turn out to be noise / faded / unreliable; the few that survive all carry their uncertainty. Not advice · can be wrong · the past != the future.
